records.issue_text: scheduleEmailReminders.ts cleanup loop awaits client.request per reminder sequentially with no timeout in a single try/catch that only logs; a failure or hang on reminder N aborts the loop leaving later reminders not cancelled at SendGrid until a subsequent run
records.rationale: In `scheduleEmailReminders.ts`, the new sweep queries `workflowReminder.findMany({ where: { cancelled: true, scheduledDate: { lte: ... }}})` and then unconditionally does `await client.request(... body: { batch_id: reminder.referenceId, status: "cancel" })` for each reminder. There is no guard for `reminder.referenceId` being null/undefined (and no `scheduled` filter either).
